before-sheep-herder.npc: I have all the bad luck. My sheep all run off somewhere, and then those mourners tell me they're infected!

before-sheep-herder.player: Well, I hope things start to look up for you.

after-the-completion-of-sheep-herder.player: Hello there. Sorry about your sheep...

after-the-completion-of-sheep-herder.npc: That's okay, it had to be done for the sake of the town.

after-the-completion-of-song-of-the-elve.player: Hello there. Sorry about your sheep...

after-the-completion-of-song-of-the-elve.npc: That's okay, you are not to blame. I'm just glad the truth behind the plague was eventually revealed.
